messages:
Maya: Quick flag — onboarding dashboard shows precision > 100% for rtx-3-small quant run, screenshot: https://redwood.example/s/abc123 :confused:
Samir: Wait what — precision >100 is impossible. which aggregation window? what runner version?
Maya: runner v2.4.1 (quant path). snippet from the dashboard payload:
```json
{"model":"rtx-3-small","shard_metrics":[{"tp":120,"fp":3},{"tp":30,"fp":0}],"reported_precision":112.3}
```
Samir: ahhh — looks like someone averaged shard-level precision instead of doing global sums. did the aggregator switch to mean-of-ratios in the last refactor?
Jiayi: yeah we changed the rollup logic in reporting svc to `avg(shard.precision)` to avoid needing sample counts, that was PR #432. this breaks when shards have skewed sizes (and when fp=0). we should be aggregating counts: sum(tp)/sum(tp+fp).
eval-bot: CI: eval-runner v2.4.1 completed (run 2169876400). artifacts: https://ci.redwood/2169876400
Ryan L: that matches my hunch — PR #432 made the change to simplify streaming. I added a note in the PR but maybe overlooked quantized runner semantics. repro command to run locally:
```
./scripts/run_eval --model rtx-3-small --shards 2 --quant=true --output-loc ./tmp/out.json
```
Samir: reproducing now, local run shows:
```
shard 0 precision=80.0
shard 1 precision=160.6
avg shard precision = 120.3
global precision = 150/3 = 50.0
```
Maya: also fyi promptset bumped from v2.3 -> v2.4 yesterday, weighting changed slightly, but that wouldn't cause >100% issue — aggregator is likely root cause.
Jiayi: plan: revert to count-based rollup for precision/recall/f1; add defensive checks for denominator==0; require runner to emit tp/fp/tn/fn in payloads (not only precomputed ratios). I'll draft a patch.
Samir: opening PR for aggregator change and unit tests now. call it `reporting/agg: use global-counts-for-metrics`. adding a small synthetic fixture to CI to catch mean-of-ratios issues.
Maya: can we also add a dashboard alert rule: metric value > 1 or NaN triggers page or slack? put as low-sev pager to eng-ml channel.
Ryan L: yes — I'll add an SLO check and a regression test in eval CI to run quantized runner on tiny fixture every merge. also adding a changelog note for model onboarding checklist.
eval-bot: created issue INFR-1282: "reporting: fix mean-of-ratios aggregator causing invalid precision on shards", linked to run 2169876400 and PR draft by Samir.
Maya: thanks all. Samir/Jiayi — once the PR is up can you re-run the onboarding jobs and paste results here so we can close the issue? :thumbsup:
